long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in law at Heidelberg, Hamburg and Kiel, Guido Krass began his business career in real-estate development and private equity in Houston and Munich. He then built CENTROTEC by founding and acquiring specialized manufacturers focused on energy-efficient heating, ventilation and building technologies, remaining closely involved in strategy and leadership as its principal shareholder.

A major portfolio shift came in 2023, when CENTROTEC transferred its climate-systems businesses to Ariston for cash and a substantial shareholding. Krass joined Ariston's board while continuing to lead CENTROTEC as it developed into a family investment company. Its remit now combines independent industrial companies, urban real estate, financial assets and venture investments, extending the acquisition-led method that shaped the original manufacturing group.

He then built CENTROTEC by founding and acquiring specialized manufacturers focused on energy-efficient heating, ventilation and building technologies, remaining closely involved in strategy and leadership as its principal shareholder.

A major portfolio shift came in 2023, when CENTROTEC transferred its climate-systems businesses to Ariston for cash and a substantial shareholding. Krass joined Ariston's board while continuing to lead CENTROTEC as it developed into a family investment company. Its remit now combines independent industrial companies, urban real estate, financial assets and venture investments, extending the acquisition-led method that shaped the original manufacturing group.
